subject: ADR-214: nine stations charted a morning's run and let you carry away none of it
body: ADR-213 took the ecology lab from 32 figures that reach no file to 19 and named what was left: the nine stations, rendered from a session JSON by nine independent renderers, whose readings belong to a RUN rather than to a pre-registration. A reader could see that a run's meadow came back at J' 0.52 with 11 effective species and a Chao1 of 103.5 and had exactly one way to carry it anywhere -- retype it off the screen. The obvious objection is that the reader already has the session JSON, and it is the same argument ADR-213 refused for the workbench: HAVING THE INPUTS IS NOT HAVING THE ANSWERS. runRecord(S) takes the same field each tile takes and formats it the same way, and does not touch the DOM -- that is the whole difference between a record and a transcript, because a record scraped out of the page would agree with the page by construction, could never catch it being wrong, and the check holding the two together would be a check on nothing. Built from S they can disagree, and verify_eco reads the figures off the TILES and requires each of them in the record. A page with no session carries no record card rather than a header over nothing, and the lab's own task presses the button and holds the bytes so it is not one more export nothing reads (ADR-153). Six Terrarium readings are declared right to stay on the screen: the two live demonstrations redraw on every drag, so the figure is a picture of a parameter you are moving rather than a record of anything that happened. 132 of 317 at ADR-211, 19 at ADR-213, 0 now.
